description:
A payment resolved down to what it would actually do, and the id that
submits it. Nothing has moved.

amount_native.description: What leaves the wallet, in the network's base unit.

expires_at_epoch_ms.description: After this the plan is refused and the payment must be re-planned.

fee_estimate_native.description:
What the network is expected to charge on top. An estimate: the chain
charges what it charges, and the reservation is taken against this.

fee_unit.description: Unit both amounts are quoted in (`sats`, `lamports`, `gwei`).

operation.description: `send` or `cashu_send` — which confirm route accepts this plan.

plan_id.description: Submit this to the matching confirm operation. Single-use.

spend_debits.description: The spend-limit budgets confirming this plan would debit.

to.description:
The destination exactly as the payment will use it, normalised. Absent
for a Cashu token mint.

wallet.description:
The wallet afpay picked, which may differ from the one requested when
the request left it open.

warnings.description: Safety signals that must be considered before confirming the plan.

items.description:
A review-time warning attached to a resolved payment plan.

Warnings are part of the plan result rather than diagnostic logs, so a
caller cannot hide a safety signal by disabling log categories.

title: PayPlanResult
